name: Rachel Lawson
story: Rachel Lawson was the 2023 New Zealand Esri Young Scholar while studying at the University of Auckland. Her award-winning project examined the effect of the New Zealand International Convention Centre fire on human mobility, combining GIS datasets and social-media imagery to analyse disrupted movement, smoke exposure and public response.

Her project is a documented example of GIS being used to study a recent urban emergency through mobility and volunteered digital information, and it connected university GIS study with the international Esri Young Scholar programme.

New Zealand Geospatial Research Conference 2022 programme, Massey Geoinformatics Collaboratory lists Rachel Lawson as an author of “Crowdsourcing tsunami and sound observations in Aotearoa after the Hunga eruption”.
